q.t: Nandini has 7 balushahi and Chirag has 5. How many do they have in all?
q.e: ‘In all’ means put them together: 7 + 3 = 10, then 2 more = 12.

q.e: Adding 10 adds one ten and keeps the ones digit 7: 17.

q.t: Which word tells you to subtract?
q.e: Take away means some are removed. Total, sum and added to all mean add.

q.e: From 37 jump 3 to 40, then 10 to 50, then 2 to 52: 3 + 10 + 2 = 15.

q.e: 83, 73, 63 — each jump back takes away one ten.

q.t: In Nani Maa’s magic square one row is 2, 7, 6. What do these add up to?
q.e: 2 + 7 = 9, and 9 + 6 = 15. In this magic square every row adds to 15.

q.e: 134 − 34 = 100 already, and we still take away 22 more, so it drops below 100 (it is 78).

q.e: 83 needs 17 more. One turn adds at most 10, so it takes at least 2 turns (for example 10 then 7).

Team Red made 56 runs before lunch and 65 after. Team Blue made 109 runs. Who won, and by how many runs?
q.e: Team Red made 56 + 65 = 121, which is 12 more than 109.

q.t: Babli sold 34 books on Monday and 45 on Tuesday. She wants to sell 100 books in three days. How many must she sell on Wednesday?
q.e: Two days: 34 + 45 = 79. To reach 100 she needs 100 − 79 = 21.
